== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Awakening]] is a mysterious and poorly understood process used to create many of the most potent weapons in [[The Empire|the Empire]], as well as [[Soulbound]] entities. While anyone is capable of using an Awakened weapon, only a [[Soulbound]] can utilize its power without restriction. These objects possess unique properties and varying degrees of potency; some are described as having a mind of their own, while others can be used to melt stone or steal power from a user's [[Vessel]]. Many [[Awakened blades]] exhibit a corrosive effect, particularly against [[Elderspawn]], which they can dissolve into sludge. However, this effectiveness is limited against higher-ranking entities like [[Handmaidens]]. [[Awakened items]] can range from small tools like padlocks and daggers to massive spears carved from the corpses of ancient beings. Some weapons are imbued with specific historical legacies, such as the resentment of fallen rebels or the blood of significant figures, and can even be used to pilot specialized ships.}}
